title: Awaz Do Baba
body:
Amma ka dard e dil abhi accha na huwa

Beti bulane wala jo khamosh ho gaya
Laash e pidar kp dekh kar zainab ne di sada

Socho to zara guzregi kya kya mere dil par

Ab jate ho tou jao magar wada nibhana
Karbal ki zameen se mai pukarungi tou ana
Bandh jayega rassi me

Jal jayenge jab khaime ujad jayegi chadar

Tab tum bhi chale ana
Ke jo maine pukara
Ye tere azadar tujhe rote rahenge

Jab bhi inhe yaad ayega
Wo zakhm tumhara
Imran Saeed aao, dua mango khuda se

Padhe milke yeh nauha
Awaz do baba...x2
Awaz do baba, awaz do baba.....x4
